== Printed deployment symbol ==
The [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards9.pdf Virtual Set 9 sheet], page 4, slip 36, prints “▼ Blaster Rack.” Its page 1 icon key expands ▼ as “Deploy on table from Reserve Deck; reshuffle.” The English transcription now retains “on table” after Blaster Rack. The printed slip and current card image are unchanged. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153015/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards9.pdf Internet Archive], 24 October 2007.
